Main text in one column of running text, two paragraphs of text, a numbered section heading "§. 3." within the text, a centred heading-style block "Verf. 2." with a Latin verse quotation in italic, then a further paragraph "§. 1." continuing to the foot. main_text.l: Exspectabat itaque se Deum coram habiturủ secum colloquentem. Præsupponit
propheta priorem visionem fuisse abruptam, in
quâ viderat Deum judicem, accusatos justorum
oppressores ex tribunali alloquentem: atque eundem audiverat
eos corripientem, sententiamque contra eos
pronunciantem: at hactenus nihil post eam dixerat Prophe-
ta; qui proinde jam cupit experiri, an non eâdem
visione, & aliquo ulteriori alloquio dignarētur.
§. 3. Huic adjungit spem ulteriorem, quid referre detur
ad elenchum suum. Sermonem suum anteriorem,
per modum instantiæ prolatum, vocat תוכחה, quod
ex fœdere instituram ἐπερώτησιν seu restipulationem notat.
Ita significat Job. 23:4. 7. ut sit demonstratio juris ex lege
aut fœdere, cum convictione alterius: hæc dum
stipulationem allegat ut præstitam, infert promissi debitorem
factum qui promiserat. Hujus elenchi facultatem
concedit cuilibet fœderato Deus Jef. 1:28. ut liceat
eum convenire, & cum fiduciâ de rebus, in fœdere
promissis, compellare.
Verf. 2.
§. 1. Non frustra se, incitante spiritu sancto,
composuit propheta ad excipiendum ulterius Dei respon-
sum; unde etiam quid secutum fuerit hunc apparatum
innuit, scribens, & respondit mihi Jehovah. Hæc est divina
erga populum suum clementia, quod nolit temporibus
explorationis pios suis destitutos consolationibus: unde
illis aperit consilium suum, atque ita respondet
eo-rum

page.notes: Left margin notes: "25:39." and "Zach. 1: 9. 13. 14." are printed in the left margin beside the first paragraph; they are transcribed inside the paragraph at their position. The small mark above "habituru" in the first paragraph is a printing or scan artefact and was left as is. The Hebrew word "תוכחה" is printed in the text at §. 3 and is in Hebrew letters as printed. The "§. 3." and "§. 1." paragraph openers are printed in ordinary type and kept as paragraphs. The line "Verf. 2." is a verse reference set apart and is marked as a level 3 heading. The catchword "rum" and signature "Rr 3" are at the foot. Two very faint printing errors or uncertain letters: "habituru" (possibly "habiturum" with a worn m) and "restipulationem" are as read from the scan.
